today_paragraph: SPCX closed at $147.49, up 1.9% today, following Lockup tranche after Q3 results yesterday. Price has slipped below its 20-day average, though the longer trend is still up. The overall score is leaning bearish (-24), with one caution on the daily chart: 20-bar average above 50-bar (uptrend). Options look cheap, assuming 53% yearly volatility versus 67% the stock has actually shown. The options market expects a move of about ±3% by Oct 26.
